summary.ru: Наньчжао — царство народа бай, основная территория которого располагалась в современной провинции Юньнань в Китае. Расцвет Наньчжао приходился на VIII — IX века.
summary.en: Nanzhao, also spelled Nanchao, was a dynastic kingdom that flourished in what is now southwestern China and northern Southeast Asia during the 8th and 9th centuries, during the mid/late Tang dynasty. It was centered on present-day Yunnan in China, with its capitals in modern-day Dali City. The kingdom was officially called Dameng (大蒙) from 738 to 859 AD, Dali (大禮) from 859 to 877 and Dafengmin (大封民) from 877 to 902.
